name: com.horizonesim/plan-finder
title: Horizon eSIM
description: Find Horizon travel eSIM plans with EUR prices and plan links, coverage and phone checks.

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Finds Horizon's country, regional and global destinations by English name, slug or ISO country code, for a destination whose name is unclear or a trip through several countries. With coveringCountries (ISO-3 codes) it returns only the destinations that cover every country of the itinerary. Returns each destination's name, slug and type, without prices.

coveringCountries.description: ISO-3 country codes, for example FRA and DEU.

tools.name: list_destination_plans
tools.description: Lists the eSIM plans that Horizon sells now for one destination (a country or a region): the data amount, the number of days, the unlimited flag, the price in EUR and a link to each plan's page on horizonesim.com. Takes the destination's English name or slug, for example "Netherlands", "United States" or "europe". Prices and links are current when returned; the plan page shows the final price before purchase.

destination.description: The English name or the slug of a country or region, for example "Netherlands", "usa", "balkans" or "europe".

tools.name: get_destination_coverage
tools.description: Shows the countries and published local mobile networks for a Horizon destination, with currently verified 4G/5G claims. Use for regional coverage, a stopover, or manual network selection. Country inclusion does not guarantee signal everywhere, and an absent radio claim does not prove a network lacks that technology. This describes new-sale catalog coverage, not a customer's purchased plan or current location.

tools.name: check_device_compatibility
tools.description: Looks up a phone or cellular tablet in Horizon's curated eSIM device list. A listed model is not proof that every regional variant is compatible or carrier-unlocked, and not_listed does not mean incompatible. Matching is most reliable with the exact model name and the region where the device was sold. The lookup needs no IMEI or EID.

tools.name: get_troubleshooting_steps
tools.description: Returns Horizon's approved steps for one eSIM problem, in the customer's language and in the order to try them: the eSIM does not install, no signal, signal but no internet, slow data, or the hotspot does not work. None of the steps deletes the eSIM.

issue.description: install: the eSIM does not install. signal: no signal. internet: signal but no internet. slow: the connection is slow. hotspot: the hotspot does not work.

platform.description: The customer's phone: ios for an iPhone, android for an Android phone, unknown when the customer did not say.

locale.description: The customer's language code, one of en, sq, de, tr, fr, ar, pl, es, ru, hr, it, zh, he, ja, af. Other codes get English.

tools.name: get_support_policy
tools.description: Answers activation and first-use timing, refund eligibility, hotspot and speed policy, or human support availability from Horizon's shared policy constants. No order ID or verification is needed. This never performs a refund or a handoff.
